translationRepairs: The guilt of these two men is not yet clear. The matter should be reported to the empress dowager and thoroughly investigated. If they are truly innocent, execution can wait."
The guilt of these two men is not yet clear. The matter should be reported to the empress dowager and thoroughly investigated. If they are truly not wronged, it will not be too late to execute them."

s0166 若果無冤，誅之未晚 means if investigation shows they are not wrongfully condemned (charges hold), execution will not be too late; "innocent" / "execution can wait" reverses that condition and softens 誅之未晚. The proposed wording restores the Chinese logic.
